text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the 
Twinkle Series, Biko Pegasus enjoyed 
massive success and became quite famous—

Something that should have been utterly 
impossible became reality.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, for real, seriously, my 
Hollywood movie deal is set!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I did it, Trainer! I finally get to 
be in a movie!
choice_data_list:
No, actually appearing on screen is a bit 
much...

text_block_list.text:
...I never did get an offer to star in it. 
But the movie really was produced, and on 
its opening day—
(Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Today, we have two guests with us: the 
lead actor and Biko Pegasus-san!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heheh, Justice Biko, has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
First, Biko Pegasus-san. Please share a 
few words about this work!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! When I first heard about it, I was 
really surprised! But!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, big sis, it turned into an 
amazing movie! Make sure to watch it, 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Come to think of it, 
the two of you are close outside of work 
as well, right?

Not only did she star as the lead, but she 
also offered to do the suit acting 
herself.

Thanks to that, the entire movie was 
overflowing with Biko Pegasus's unique 
charm. It truly was a tour de force 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the moment has arrived. Let's 
hear from our lead actor.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"This work is your third since your debut, 
isn't it? It has generated huge buzz and 
is finally your big breakthrough—"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Being able to appear in the work I 
wanted to bring to life the most, the one 
I absolutely wanted to be in—nothing could 
be more fulfilling than this.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Through this production, Biko-chan and I 
were able to pour our entire hearts into 
our performance. That is why...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: I have—no regrets anymore.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, big... sis?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Please be sure to watch my final 
performance. It was for a short time, 
but... thank you so much!

A sudden announcement. Retiring after only 
three works was lamented by many, but—

There was also an unavoidable reason for 
it.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Biko-chan, Trainer. I know this is 
out of nowhere. But...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
My body just won't move anymore. 
Especially for that last piece... I gave 
it my absolute all, until my body was 
completely worn down.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“B-But won't you regret it?! You finally 
had the chance to become a world star!”

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Of course, part of me wanted 
to do more, but...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any regrets. How could I? 
After all, the reason I could shine this 
brightly was—

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Because when it was time to compete, she 
fought fearlessly without dreading the 
sacrifices—and won."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"That's the Carrot Soul between me and 
Biko-chan! Right?"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I executed... the action that only I could 
do.

Her expression looked refreshed and clear. 
And—it was beautiful.

Fulfilling one's own life and burning it 
out completely. That devotion is just 
like—

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? What is it?"

Humans and Umamusume. Different as they 
are, the color of their souls... felt just 
the same as Biko Pegasus's.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! She said she's going to hold 
action workshops all over the world!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And so, they're gonna raise the next hero! 
Sounds like they've already found an 
amazing prospect!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Look at this!

Looking over, an Umamusume was gallantly 
racing across the grassy field.

She's fast enough to rival Biko Pegasus. 
She might just put up a good fight in a 
race.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
She's, um... a trainee from Denmark, 
apparently!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Tons of other amazing girls are gathering, 
looks like our big sis is super popular!
choice_data_list: I see... I'm glad to hear that...
I see... That's great for you...

text_block_list.text:
The bond between Biko Pegasus and her 
sister. That action will continue to be 
passed down across the world.

Only three works. Yet what blossomed so 
brilliantly there continues on without 
end.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to... lose here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to be the number one hero 
in this country! And—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Multiply, heroes of the world! Someday 
I'll gather everyone together for an epic 
showdown!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And the one who's gonna unleash the most 
awesome special move of all is me, Justice 
Biko!!

The heroic spirit that coursed through 
Biko Pegasus. Her small build and 
fragility were certainly undeniable, 
but...

"Even so, its instantaneous burst of speed 
was tremendous. It became one of the 
bloodlines that took the world by storm."

Biko Pegasus is one of those 
representatives. No matter what kind of 
wall stands before her—

Facing challenges undaunted with nothing 
but sheer courage. That gallant figure 
electrified the fans, marking an 
unforgettable hero.
